body.name: \(a_n^{\dagger}\)
body.def: Put \(a_n^{\dagger}=0\) when \(t_n^{\dagger}<t/2\).  When \(t_n^{\dagger}\geq t/2\), let \(D_n=2\sigma_0^2\{\lambda_{n,\mathcal R}^{-1}-\lambda_{n,\mathcal R}/(\lambda_{n,\mathcal R}+2t_n^{\dagger}\lambda_{n,\mathcal E})^2\}\) and \(B_n=2(1-\varkappa_n)/(2-\varkappa_n)\), and set \(a_n^{\dagger}=\{D_n/[B_n^2+K_n^{\dagger}/n]\}^{1/2}\).
